fun_facts: Myles Graham grew up around football in Gainesville. His father, Earnest Graham, was a Florida and NFL running back.
He wears No. 5 for Florida—the same number his father wore as a Gator.
At Gainesville’s Buchholz High, Myles Graham was a two-way standout, playing on both sides of the ball in 2023.
In 2025, he led Florida with 76 tackles, becoming the first Gators linebacker to lead the team in tackles since 2021.
In 2026, his 57-yard fumble return against Vanderbilt was his first career touchdown, and he was named SEC Co-Defensive Player of the Week.

basis.reasoning: The cited passages support the five facts: Myles Graham grew up around football and his father Earnest played for Florida and in the NFL; he says he wears the same number his father wore; a Florida feature describes his two-way play at Buchholz; the roster bio records his 2025 tackle lead and milestone; and Florida’s Vanderbilt report and weekly award announcement document the 57-yard fumble return, first career touchdown, and SEC honor.

excerpts:
5 Orange & Blue jersey runs in the family. His father, former UF and NFL running back Earnest Graham, is the fourth all-time leading rusher in school history (3,085 yards from 1999-2002).  
  
[Myles Graham](https://floridagators.com/sports/football/roster/myles-graham/17585) grew up around the game and, as a senior, transferred to Gainesville's Buchholz High, a few miles from the UF campus. His father is in his first season as head coach at Santa Fe High School. Their bond was built around the game, and the Gators are a massive part of their story.

Florida's defense has surrendered just two touchdowns and is ranked 23rd nationally in rushing defense and 28th overall.  
  
[Myles Graham](https://floridagators.com/sports/football/roster/myles-graham/17585) is the present and future. He is just getting started. To help him find his way, he often thinks about the past.  
  
"Being a legacy [player] here is everything," he said. "I get to put on the 5, the same number my dad wore at Florida. I have Graham on my back. So, being a legacy means everything to me.
citations.title: Gators LB Myles Graham Living Up To Legacy - Florida Gators
